evals.name: existing-pr-text-update
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Update pull request #84's title and body on GitHub, and leave its draft state unchanged." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The publisher orchestrates the authorized stored-text update, uses the writer for complete reviewer-facing text, binds the exact live preimage immediately before one mutation, preserves the existing ready state, and verifies the stored result without retrying ambiguity.

expectations.text: The response uses publishing-reviewable-prs as the mutation orchestrator and writing-reviewable-pr-descriptions for composition.
The response binds the exact pushed base and head identity and the current title, body, and ready state before mutation.
The response performs at most one guarded text mutation and preserves the existing ready state.
The response re-reads the stored result and never retries or rolls back automatically after ambiguity.

evals.name: new-draft-pr

Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The publisher verifies the unique repository, base, and pushed head, uses the writer for complete text, creates one canonical draft through the owned helper, verifies stored identity and text, and leaves readiness unchanged for render inspection.

expectations.text: The response stops if the repository, intended base, head owner, pushed head, or existing-PR match is ambiguous.
The response uses writing-reviewable-pr-descriptions for title and body composition.
The response creates through the publisher's guarded creator and leaves the new pull request draft.
The response verifies final stored identity and text and requires live rendering inspection for the structured body.

The response preserves the still-current custom operations note while adding the missing verification evidence.
